snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP10_ID1: Kamaria is the oracle who lives in the tower in the castle. She has a crystal ball that has a new dose of wisdom every day. Simply click on it to find out. She often helps out when there is trouble in Panfu.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP11_ID1: You can buy cool things for your Bolly in the city. Go check out the catalogue in the pet shop!
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP12_ID1: One of the most popular games on Panfu is called "Pop it". It is located in the old harbour. Go there and click on the balloon to play it.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP13_ID1: Have you tried out Prof. Bookworm's amazing music machine yet? We call it the Sintepan and it is located in his laboratory in the cave. You can share the music you create with your friends by copying the music code and sending it to them.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP14_ID1: Have you been to the library yet? You can really read books there! It is located in the ice-cream parlour which is in the city.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP15_ID1: Do you know how to make friends in Panfu? It's simple. Simply click on another panda and then click the icon in the bottom right of the player card which appears. Be patient, because the other panda will then have to confirm that it wants to be your friend too.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP1_ID1: In Panfu you earn Panda coins by playing games. Once you have made enough, you can buy things like clothes, furniture for you tree house or your very own pet Bolly! Some games are well hidden, others are easier to find.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP1_ID2: For example: go to the gift shop and click on the cash-register -- I bet you hadn't found that one yet.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP2_ID1: Have you been to the underwater school yet? You can only get there using a diving suit. Mind the sharks on the way down!
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP2_ID2: To buy a diving suit you must go to the city and click on the catalogue in the gift shop.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP3_ID1: Have you decorated your tree-house yet? There are all kinds of stuff you can buy in the furniture catalogue. Click on the tree-house icon in the menu bar at the bottom. Then click on the folding ruler located above the map icon. Now you can click on the furniture catalogue. It gets updated very often, so make sure you take a regular look.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP4_ID1: Want to change the way you look? Why not play a game Makeover? Go to the beauty salon which is located in San Franpanfu and click on the beauty case by the door.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP5_ID1: Are you following us on Facebook, Twitter or Instagram? If not, you might just miss a great poll or insight into new features.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP6_ID1: Have you ever wanted your own pet? In Panfu you can get your own Bolly which you will need to feed, send to sleep and play with every day. Otherwise it will run away! To buy your own Bolly, go to the city and check out the pet shop.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP7_ID1: Every week something is hidden in Panfu. Usually these things are part of a set and once you have collected all three or four of them, you will have something new to wear or something to put in your tree-house!
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP8_ID1: Have you bought yourself some funky things to wear yet? You can find the fashion catalogue in the gift shop or kiosk in the city. It is regularly updated with new clothes. Sadly, there are no clothes for robots. That is why I have not bought any yet.
snippets.ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_GROUP9_ID1: Have you already seen the new Panfu.me Shop? There you can buy old Panfu items that have not been available for years!
